Name: Turn Charlie Blue for SVE
Author: bunnyverse
Description:
♡ hello! ♡

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] (SVE) lets a certain bachelor's favorite chicken roam around the valley after you see one of his later heart events.
And as you may know, the original vanilla game introduces us to the mystical [color=#3c78d8]blue[/color] chicken.
These facts are both very cool on their own, but I wanted to combine them...

Thus...
This mod turns Charlie the chicken into Charlie the ~[color=#3c78d8]blue[/color]~ chicken!

Charlie is a very special chicken, so why not let her image reflect that? It's very cute to see a blue chicken waddle in the forest and through the town~
